JACKSON STATE

Jackson State football's Kam Sallis, Quaveon Davis named preseason FCS All-Americans

Tia Reid
Mississippi Clarion Ledger
Aug. 10, 2026, 4:22 p.m. CT
Listen to audio version of this article

Jackson State football is expected to have multiple players be among the best in the FCS.

Offensive lineman Quaveon Davis and defensive back Kam Sallis were named preseason FCS All-Americans. Sallis made the second-team defense in FCS Football Central's list, and Davis made the third-team offense in Stats Perform's list.
